title: Unit – 1 : Session – 7 | Clarity of the Basic Aspiration
sections: Q1. The sequence: my PRESENT EFFORT (study, job, projects) is to BECOME something (engineer, officer); becoming that is to GET/DO something (salary, house, recognition); getting/doing that is to BE something — ultimately to BE HAPPY and PROSPEROUS in continuity. So every effort, however different on the surface, is only a step toward the same single destination. The BASIC ASPIRATION is continuous happiness and prosperity. Recognising this chain prevents mistaking any intermediate step (money, position) for the goal itself.

Q2. Life WITH clarity: every effort is evaluated against the real goal — I know how much physical facility is enough, relationships get priority, decisions are quick and definite, effort is satisfying, and there is no burnout-chasing. Life WITHOUT clarity: goals keep shifting (marks → job → promotion → more money), no achievement settles the inner want, comparison and competition dominate, and success co-exists with anxiety — effort increases but fulfilment does not.

Q3. When a favourite PATH is closed, the appropriate response is to change the path, not the goal — because the path was only a means; the basic aspiration remains achievable by other routes. Despair or stubbornness comes from identifying the path with the goal ('if not this exam/job, my life is over'). With clarity of aspiration, one re-examines the assumption, keeps the goal fixed, and flexibly chooses another way — this keeps happiness intact and conduct definite.
